text:
zoe: PSA: someone left a very heroic-looking stack of pancakes in the kitchen. plate says "free for team" but no name.
mark: i found one pancake shaped like a heart and considered keeping it, but then felt guilty. returned to plate. :relieved:
lucy: whoops that was me. made too many for brunch experiment. sorry for not labeling. pancakes are blueberry-banana with questionable syrup ratio.
harry: questionable syrup = character. i volunteer as taste-tester. :raised_hands:
zoe: left a tiny card: "take 1, be courteous". also someone wrote "do not microwave, will explode" in sharpie on the foil. fair warning.
mark: can we start a "kitchen etiquette 101" channel or is that micro-managing snacks? :thinking_face:
lucy: maybe just a magnet board with rules. rule 1: label it. rule 2: if you claim it, don't hide it in the back like a treasure.
devops-bot: (devops-bot) note: kitchen sensors report plate removed at 09:17, remaining stack: 2. temperature normal.
harry: also, for future experiments, please post "contains nuts" or "kitchen science inside". allergies are real.
mark: agood morning ritual: every friday someone brings baked goods and we applaud them in general? :clap:
zoe: yes. weekly pastry praise.
lucy: i'll add "Free Pastries Friday" to our internal calendar and claim honorific pastry-maker duties next week.
devops-bot: (devops-bot) calendar event created: Free Pastries Friday - Organizer: lucy
harry: owed gratitude to lucy. also reward: extra coffee voucher.
mark: thread voted: :thumbsup: 4 for weekly pastries, :thumbsdown: 0. decision: pastry party.
zoe: moral of story: label your food or live on the edge and share pancakes for the team. :pancakes:
